result.citation: Cella v. Attorney General, SJC-13893 (Mass. June 23, 2026)
result.citation_basis: Cella v. Attorney General and SJC-13893: D059 and O101; June 23, 2026: D059 (dateline) and O101 (cites line and 'Published June 23, 2026'); Mass. (Supreme Judicial Court): D059 and O101
result.note: The citation now uses the lawyer's form, which D059 and O101 support with no conflicting docket number or date; per D059 and O101 the Supreme Judicial Court held that Initiative Petition 25-21 (statewide rent control) is barred from the November 2026 ballot under Article 48 because its religious-facility exemption impermissibly relates to religion, and the card's quote stays from D059, a news report, since no supplied document is the court's opinion.
